Green Cards or US Citizens only 
 
 Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Job Title: Peoplesoft Developer 
 Location: Herndon, VA (Locals or Nearby) 
 Duration: 6 months 
 
 Looking for a level II or III 
 The PeopleSoft Developer is a developer in the technical delivery and support of PeopleSoft HCM and FSCM modules. The candidate must possess advanced (for the III)/ senior-level (for the II) experience working in two modules in PeopleSoft HCM/FSCM Version 9.2. The candidate must possess advanced (for the III)/ senior-level (for the II) ability to create technical documentation: 
 ability to develop technical system designs, develop technical program specifications, and develop technical testing requirements. 
 · Refine and decompose requirements to the level of detail required to initiate coding 
 · Review and accept software and interface design and requirements 
 · Implement code as specified in the design and ensures the implemented software fully satisfies functional and technical requirements 
 · Develop technical system design documents 
 · Participate in functional BRD and technical design review 
 
 Required Skills: 
 · Level III - Minimum 7 years of progressive work experience focused on PeopleSoft application design, development, documentation, testing, and implementation in full life-cycle projects Level II – 5 years 
 · Level III - Minimum 7 years of PeopleSoft HCM/FSCM 9.1/9.2, Application Designer, PeopleCode, Component Interface, Application Engine, SQR’s, Integration Technologies, SQL, Security, and PS/Query Level II – 5 years 
 · Strong functional and technical experience with core Human Resources and Workflow 
 · Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills; demonstrate a customer centric focus, and the ability to work independently 
 · Must be highly organized · Ability to apply analytical thinking to solve business problems using technology 
 
 Desired Skills: 
 · Experience with Web Services 
 · Developing Fluid Pages 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
